d: Ek taraph mokama se vidhayak anant sinh apni chhoti beti ki shadi ki taiyariyon men vyast hain, vahin dusri taraph bihar vidhanasbha ne unhen ek bara jhatka diya hai. parti virodhi gatividhiyon ke aarop men vidhanasbha sachiv sanjay kumar sinh ne adhyaksh prem kumar ke nirdesh par anant sinh ko notis jari kiya hai aur 7 dinon ke bhitar javab manga hai. somvar ko anant sinh ne yah notis prapt bhi kar liya hai.
